lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶，鬼杀队的猎物来了！
lines.en: Sssss, prey of the Demon Slayers.

lines.zh: 阴暗之地，就是我的领地！

lines.en: I hide from the sun's light.
I am the Demon Slayers' nightmare.
My horns shatter all in their path.

lines.zh: 在这片黑暗中，我无所不能！
角撞在岩壁上，火星四溅
lines.en: My horn strikes stone and throws sparks

lines.zh: 我的血鬼术将吞噬你们！
这对角撞上你，护甲也会裂。
lines.en: These horns will crack even armor.

lines.zh: 我的存在是对你们的诅咒！

lines.en: In this shadow, I live on.
Demon Slayers, your end is here.
My horn points at you; don't back against the wall.
Demon Slayers, you're doomed — Horned Demon, look player

lines.zh: 你们的恐惧是我的乐趣！

lines.en: You have no chance, Demon Slayers.
The horn on my head is harder than a blade.

lines.zh: 我的角撞在门框上，裂了。
lines.en: I cracked my horn on the door frame.

lines.zh: 疼得我把墙抓出五道沟。
lines.en: The pain makes me gouge five furrows in the wall.

lines.zh: 角上裂了一道，血流进眼。
lines.en: A crack in my horn, blood in my eye.

lines.zh: 我的角还在，就能站起来。
lines.en: My horns are intact, so I can rise again.

lines.zh: 我的角裂了，先让我吃一口。
lines.en: My horn is cracked — let me eat first.
This wound is not enough to make me retreat

lines.zh: 我闻到的不是饭，是人味。
lines.en: What I smell is not food but human.

lines.zh: 鬼杀队的，我要吃掉你们！
lines.en: Dagger Corps, I'll feast on you!

lines.zh: 你们身上有我爱的食物！
我的角能碾碎你的骨头！
黑夜是我的猎场，你是我的猎物！
lines.en: Night is my hunt, you are prey!

lines.zh: 阳光让我痛苦，但我不会退缩！
lines.en: Sunlight hurts, but I won't yield!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队，我不会放过你们！
我的血鬼术会将你吞噬！

lines.en: Avoid me, or you'll be hurt!

lines.zh: 你撞上我的护甲，肩膀先响。
lines.en: You hit my armor; your shoulder cracks first.

lines.zh: 我们碰撞一次吧，你会输！
我的护甲能挡住你的攻击！
你的武器碰不到我的皮！

lines.en: You can't hit me, I'll get closer!

lines.zh: 我的速度超越你的想象！
找到我的同类，才能生存！

lines.en: Mate with me, you'll be stronger!

lines.zh: 找一个可以一起战斗的！
lines.en: Find a partner to fight with!

lines.zh: 我的同类是唯一的依靠！
lines.en: My mate is my only hope!

lines.zh: 找到我的伴侣，才能真正强大！
lines.en: Find my mate to truly grow!
My power comes from my mate!

lines.zh: 我的伴侣是唯一的真爱！
lines.en: My mate is the only true one!

lines.zh: 这角上的力量，不容小觑！
我的角可不止用来装饰！
lines.en: These horns are for more than just looks.
Ghost Slayer, you've got the wrong one!

lines.zh: 我的血鬼术能吸取灵魂！

lines.en: I don't want to be your friend!
Ghost Slayers, nowhere to hide! — Horned Demon, target acquire
My horns will guide the hunt!
Ghost Slayers, escape is a myth!

lines.zh: 队服上的纹，夜里我也看得见。
lines.en: I can see the crest on that uniform even at night.
Your nichirin blade just caught the light
I see the crest on your uniform

lines.zh: 手臂上爬满血纹，猎杀开始了。
lines.en: Blood veins crawl up my arm; the hunt begins.
You've come to feed me again

lines.zh: 我不急，天亮前还有时间。
lines.en: No hurry; there is time before dawn.

lines.zh: 角尖已经对准你的后颈。
lines.en: The tip of my horn is aimed at the nape of your neck.

lines.zh: 我的角将贯穿你的身体！
lines.en: My horns will tear through you!

lines.zh: 鬼杀队，你们的末日来了！
lines.en: Ghost Slayers, your end is here!

lines.zh: 我的血鬼术将把你吞噬！
lines.en: My blood magic will consume you!

lines.zh: 你握刀的手势我记住了

lines.en: The shadow under the eaves is mine

lines.zh: 你退到窗边，光就在外面
lines.en: Back to the window, and the sun is outside

lines.zh: 我不怕你的刀，我怕太阳
lines.en: Your blade doesn't scare me. The sun does
You guard high. I kick low
My art curls around behind you
Time enough to play before dawn
My horn tip flips your sword away!
Blood art coils around your ankle!
I charge in along your blade!
Pinned to the wall, horn against you.
I bite the hand holding your sword!
At night my horns break the window first.

lines.zh: 角从额头长出来，天黑了。
lines.en: Horns out of my brow. Night has come.
In the night, horns push out of the dark

lines.zh: 屋后的阴影站起一个我
lines.en: A shadow behind the house stands up
The smell of blood drew me here
The moon rises, and I open my eyes

lines.zh: 水灌进我的角根，呛得慌。
lines.en: Water pours into the root of my horn and I choke.

lines.zh: 爆炸撞上我的角，火星四散。
lines.en: The blast hit my horns and sparks scattered.
An arrow struck my horn. My hide is too thick.
Not enough blood. My horns are going cold.
